About 23,300,000 resultsThe compilation album "No New York" is widely regarded as the quintessential representation of the No Wave movement, showcasing its unique musical aesthetic and avant-garde spirit.
Overview of No Wave Movement
The No Wave movement emerged in the late 1970s in Downtown New York City, characterized by its rejection of traditional rock music aesthetics and a focus on noise, dissonance, and atonality. It was a reaction against the commercialism of the new wave genre and punk rock's recycling of rock clichés. Instead, No Wave artists experimented with various styles, including free jazz, funk, and avant-garde noise music, often reflecting an abrasive and confrontational worldview. Wikipedia

This album is considered a landmark in the No Wave genre, encapsulating the raw energy and experimental nature of the movement. 2
